correctness.evidence: Provable defects on paths that are supposed to work. (1) `recording: {enabled: true}` writes zero files: RecordingConfig.criteria defaults to None (training_v2_config.py:334); runner.py:522 serialises with model_dump(exclude_none=True), dropping it; recorder.py:254 does config.get('criteria', {}) -> {}; :258 periodic.get('enabled', False) -> False; :263 returns False always. Verified by executing the real schema: payload = {'enabled': True, 'output_dir': 'recordings'}. Runner still logs 'Episode recording enabled' (runner.py:533) and spawns a writer thread (recorder.py:61-66). (2) `compression: 'none'` produces permanently unreadable files: recorder.py:283-287 writes raw msgpack, :291 still names it .msgpack.lz4, replay.py:67 unconditionally lz4.frame.decompress, and the bare `except Exception` at replay.py:85-88 swallows it into `return False`. Any value other than 'lz4' hits the same else-branch. (3) Three visualization payloads the frontend depends on are emitted nowhere in src/: `grep -rn 'heat_map|rnd_metrics|affordance_graph' src/ --include=*.py` returns nothing, yet simulation.js:393-407 handles all three and App.vue:105,130-131,166,179-180 wires Grid's heat-map overlay, NoveltyHeatmap, IntrinsicRewardChart and AffordanceGraph to them. Those four render permanently empty. (4) The server's own versioned telemetry payload is discarded: live_inference.py:878 sends 'telemetry', simulation.js reads 'telemetry' 0 times. (5) Commands silently dropped: simulation.js:577,592 send 'load_model' and 'start_training'; live_inference.py:554-631 has no branch for either and no else/error, so they vanish. Controls.vue:230 calls startTraining(). (6) Documented CLI crashes: run_server raises ValueError when level_name is None (live_inference.py:1210-1211), but level_name is argv[6] (:1244) while CLAUDE.md documents only 5 positional args. (7) Latent: _stop_frontend reads self.frontend_process (unified_server.py:528) which __init__ (:65-92) never initialises — only _start_frontend:469 assigns it. Unreachable today only because both are dead.

specification.evidence: The WebSocket protocol is the load-bearing contract between two languages and has no schema on either side. Server message types are string literals inside dicts (live_inference.py:506,527,702,775,863,1004,1046,1091); client types are string cases in a switch (simulation.js:253-355). Nothing shared, generated, or validated — and the drift is measurable: server sends replay_loaded/recordings_list/replay_finished which the store never handles; store handles training_status/training_started/episode_complete/training_complete/paused/resumed which the server never sends (note training_status at runner.py:567,958 is a DB system_state key, not a broadcast); store sends load_model/start_training which the server never handles. Eleven drift instances. RecordingConfig is the weakest schema in the repo: model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow') (training_v2_config.py:328) against extra='forbid' on its parent TrainingV2Config (:356), and criteria is dict[str, Any] (:334) with no sub-model, so a typo like `perodic:` validates silently. Two genuine specs do exist and are the exception: TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION (live_inference.py:53) versions one payload, and database.py:47-105 is a real declared schema with indices.

test_signal.evidence: 136 tests pass and coverage is inverted — high exactly where code cannot run in production. criteria.py 96%, video_export.py 100%, video_renderer.py 96%, recorder.py 93%, replay.py 86% — all on the unreachable recording/replay slice; test_criteria.py alone is 524 lines / 15 tests / 35 assertions constraining a class (RecordingCriteria) that grep shows is imported by ZERO files in src/. Meanwhile live_inference.py is 33% with the entire command dispatch (556-631), replay handlers (974-1176), inference loop (650-793) and broadcast (798-909) uncovered, and unified_server.py is 30% with _start_frontend/_stop_frontend (447-546) uncovered. Nothing anywhere tests _handle_command. tests/test_townlet/integration/test_live_inference_websocket.py is named for the WebSocket protocol and contains two tests that only call _build_substrate_metadata() — it never opens a socket or asserts a message shape. Zero JavaScript tests exist and none can: no package.json means no test runner. The cross-language contract — the one thing that has demonstrably broken 11 times — has no test on either side.

doc_truth.evidence: Docs describe a system that does not run. CLAUDE.md's inference command `python -m townlet.demo.live_inference <checkpoint_dir> 8766 0.2 10000 <config_path>` crashes: level_name is argv[6] and run_server raises ValueError without it (live_inference.py:1210-1211,1244). docs/manual/REPLAY_USAGE.md:8-30 documents `--db` and `--recordings` flags that do not exist in the argv parser (live_inference.py:1240-1258, positional only) plus a monolithic `configs/townlet_level_2_5_temporal.yaml` that does not exist, and documents filtering recordings by reason 'periodic_100' when recorder.py:300 hardcodes reason='periodic'. docs/manual/RECORDING_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.md:5-40 diagrams a working capture->write->replay pipeline that writes zero files under every shipped config. CLAUDE.md's frontend section advertises 'heat map overlay, agent trails, novelty heatmap (RND)' — all fed by payloads emitted nowhere in src/. docs/architecture/hld/frontend-visualization.md:4 is marked 'Status: Implemented'. No doc mentions that the frontend has no package.json.

changeability.evidence: The two author-facing changes this subsystem exists to serve both require coordinated cross-language edits with no contract and no test to catch drift — and drift has already happened 11 times, which is empirical proof the changes are not safely makeable. Adding an affordance requires editing AFFORDANCE_ICON_MAP (live_inference.py:36-51) AND AFFORDANCE_ICONS (frontend/src/utils/constants.js:27-58). Adding a payload field requires editing the dict at live_inference.py:863-880 AND updateState (simulation.js:359-450) with nothing to detect a mismatch. live_inference.py is a 1258-LOC god object combining FastAPI app, checkpoint loading (:412-515), command dispatch (:554-631), inference loop (:633-793), broadcast (:795-909), grid building (:911-956), replay control (:972-1176) and CLI (:1179-1258). Genuine mitigations exist and are real: meters propagate automatically via meter_name_to_index (live_inference.py:820-824), and substrate dispatch is isolated to _build_grid_data (:911-956) and _build_substrate_metadata (:184-244). The recording package itself is cleanly separated (recorder/replay/criteria/renderer/export are independent modules).

RecordingWriter._should_record_episode reimplements only `periodic` inline and says so at recorder.py:245-246: 'For now, just check periodic criterion. Full criteria evaluator will be implemented in Phase 2.' The field that makes recording work is Optional with default=None and nothing marks it load-bearing.

Only 'lz4' is honoured; every other value (including the documented 'none') falls to recorder.py:287 `compressed = serialized`, is still written under a `.msgpack.lz4` filename (:291), and replay.py:67 unconditionally calls lz4.frame.decompress. Combined with criteria typed as bare dict[str, Any] (:334) with no sub-model, a misspelled key such as `perodic:` or `critera:` validates cleanly and is silently discarded. declared_but_inert.evidence: CREATE INDEX idx_recordings_reason ON episode_recordings(recording_reason) builds an index on a column that recorder.py:300 hardcodes to the literal 'periodic' with the comment 'For now, all recordings are periodic'. The filter API that consumes it (database.py:339-386, exposed over WebSocket at live_inference.py:1020-1049 and documented in REPLAY_USAGE.md as filterable by 'periodic_100') can therefore only ever match one value.

keep_these: src/townlet/demo/database.py entirely — clean declared SQL schema with sensible indices (:47-105), parameterised inserts, context-manager lifecycle (:399-406) and a __del__ safety net (:408), 88% covered by 15 real tests. The best-engineered file in this subsystem.

Substrate-agnostic broadcast, which is the product thesis actually working: _build_grid_data type-dispatch (live_inference.py:911-956), _build_substrate_metadata (:184-244), dynamic meters via meter_name_to_index (:820-824), and position_dim-driven affordance encoding (:833-847). Change the substrate in YAML and the UI payload adapts without a code edit.

The action-mask length check at live_inference.py:809-815, which raises ValueError rather than truncating when mask length != action_dim, with a message that names the config as the fix. Exactly the fail-loudly behaviour CLAUDE.md asks for.

Dimensionality-agnostic step capture at recorder.py:120-137, which builds position tuples from positions.shape[0] and so handles 2D/3D/aspatial without branching.

TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION and build_agent_telemetry_payload (live_inference.py:53-70) — the only versioned payload contract anywhere in the protocol, with a null-population path and a real unit test. This is the right pattern; it should be extended to the whole message set rather than removed.

UnifiedServer._persist_config_snapshot (unified_server.py:97-112) — copies the active config pack into the run directory for provenance, idempotent, exception-safe, and genuinely tested (test_unified_server_unit.py:96-107).

The recording package's module separation — recorder / replay / criteria / video_renderer / video_export are independent with clean interfaces. Whatever the disposition, this decomposition is correct and made this audit tractable.
frontend/src/styles/tokens.js and variables.css — a real design-token layer with CSS custom properties, which is why the 19 live components are visually consistent.

findings.evidence: 224 LOC implementing periodic, stage_transitions, performance and stage_boundaries, at 96% coverage from 15 tests / 524 lines — and `grep -rn 'RecordingCriteria' src/` shows zero production importers. findings.title: Replay mode is unreachable end-to-end from every caller in the repository
findings.evidence: ReplayManager is constructed only when db_path AND recordings_dir are both truthy (live_inference.py:146-154). unified_server.py:401-409 passes neither. live_inference.py:1258 (__main__) calls run_server(checkpoint_dir, port, step_delay, total_episodes, config_dir, level_name, training_config) — the db_path and recordings_dir parameters (:1187-1188) are unreachable from the CLI. Combined with the recording defect, ~1,150 LOC (criteria 224, replay 222, video_renderer 342, video_export 252, plus live_inference.py:972-1176) is dead in every shipped configuration, backed by ~2,600 lines of passing tests.

findings.title: compression: 'none' silently produces permanently unreadable recordings
findings.evidence: recorder.py:283-287 honours a non-lz4 compression value by writing raw msgpack, then :291 names the file `episode_%06d.msgpack.lz4` regardless. replay.py:67 unconditionally calls lz4.frame.decompress on the bytes. The resulting exception is caught by the bare `except Exception` at :85-88 and reduced to `logger.error` + `return False`, so the operator sees 'Failed to load episode N' with no indication that the data is intact but mislabelled. Any value other than 'lz4' (e.g. 'zstd', 'gzip') hits the same else-branch — the schema at training_v2_config.py:333 accepts all of them.

findings.title: The versioned agent-telemetry payload is built, tested, broadcast, and discarded
findings.evidence: build_agent_telemetry_payload stamps TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION onto a population snapshot (live_inference.py:56-70), has a dedicated unit test (test_live_inference_unit.py:50-58), and is included in every state_update at :878. `grep -c telemetry frontend/src/stores/simulation.js` returns 0 — updateState never reads it. The one place in the whole protocol where someone bothered to version a contract is the one payload nothing consumes.

findings.title: WebSocket protocol has no schema on either side and has drifted in both directions 11 times
findings.evidence: Server->client sent but never handled: replay_loaded (:1004), recordings_list (:1046), replay_finished (:1091). Client handles but server never sends: training_started, episode_complete, training_complete, paused, resumed (simulation.js:281-348) — and training_status, whose only src occurrences (runner.py:567,958) are DB system_state writes, not broadcasts. Client->server sent but never handled: load_model (:577), start_training (:592). Message types are bare string literals in a Python dict and a JS switch with no shared definition, no codegen and no contract test; the protocol is documented only by REPLAY_USAGE.md, which is itself wrong.

findings.title: Unknown WebSocket commands are dropped silently with no error branch
findings.evidence: _handle_command is an if/elif chain ending at the set_speed branch (:626-631) with no else and no logging. Controls.vue:230 -> store.startTraining() sends {'command': 'start_training', ...} and the server discards it without a log line or an error frame; the UI shows no failure. Same for load_model. This directly violates the project's fail-loudly principle and is why the drift above went unnoticed.

findings.title: Documented entry points for this subsystem crash or reference flags that do not exist
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md documents `python -m townlet.demo.live_inference <checkpoint_dir> 8766 0.2 10000 <config_path>` — five positional args — but level_name is argv[6] (:1244) and run_server raises ValueError('level_name is required for live inference') when it is None (:1210-1211). The documented command cannot start. REPLAY_USAGE.md:16-19 documents `--db` and `--recordings` flags; the __main__ block parses positional argv only and never forwards those parameters. It also references configs/townlet_level_2_5_temporal.yaml, a monolithic config that does not exist under the v2.1 layout.

findings.title: Frontend subprocess orchestration is dead code and its docstring advertises it as a live component
findings.evidence: The class docstring lists 'Frontend Subprocess: Runs Vue dev server (npm run dev)' as component 3 and the shutdown docstring (:289) promises 'Stop frontend subprocess'. _start_frontend (:441-520, ~80 LOC with npm detection, port scraping and a 30s readiness loop) and _stop_frontend (:522-546) have zero callers — grep finds only their definitions and internal self-references. Latent bug: self.frontend_process is assigned only at :469 inside the dead _start_frontend, never in __init__ (:65-92), so _stop_frontend's `if not self.frontend_process` at :528 would raise AttributeError if ever wired up. Under the zero-backwards-compat rule this is a straight deletion.

findings.title: Eight Vue components (~2,400 LOC) are imported by nothing
findings.evidence: For each of the 27 components I counted referencing files across frontend/src: eight have zero. Controls.vue alone is 830 LOC and is the only caller of the store's startTraining() — itself a command the server drops. AffordanceLegend (277), ReferencePanel (410), DeathCertificates-adjacent FailurePanel (311) and CheckpointProgress (316) are complete, styled components wired to nothing. App.vue:193-211 imports 19 of 27.

findings.title: The declarative icon authoring path exists as a schema and is never invoked
findings.evidence: VisualCueConfig declares `icon: str | None` (cues.py:74) with a validating loader. CuesCompiler is instantiated at compiler.py:68 and that line is its only occurrence in the file — never called. No cues.yaml exists under configs/; preflight.py and raw_configs_v21.py have zero 'cues' references, so it is not part of the v2.1 pack; compiled.py exposes no cue data. The icons actually used are two hardcoded maps in two languages, and constants.js still carries a legacy camel-case block (Bed, Fridge, Job, Therapist...) for an affordance vocabulary the configs no longer use.

findings.title: ACTION_ICONS covers 5 of Grid2D's 8 actions, and the declarative action_labels the server sends are ignored by the renderer
findings.evidence: ACTION_ICONS defines numeric keys 0-4 only, while CLAUDE.md and the substrate document 8 Grid2D actions (6 substrate + INTERACT + WAIT). StatsPanel.vue:201 returns `ACTION_ICONS[action] || action`, so actions 5-7 render as raw integers. The server already sends configurable action_labels on connect (live_inference.py:527) and the store stores them (simulation.js:257-259) — the renderer just does not use them, so the declarative label presets (gaming/6dof/cardinal/math) never reach the UI.

findings.title: Aspatial mode renders an empty affordance list
findings.evidence: For AspatialSubstrate, _build_grid_data returns {'type': 'aspatial'} with no affordances key, and the server sends no top-level 'affordances' field. simulation.js:366 computes `affordances.value = message.affordances || message.grid.affordances || []`, which is therefore always []. App.vue:111 passes store.affordances to AspatialView, whose affordance-list panel (:25-36) is the component's main content. CLAUDE.md lists 'affordance list' as an AspatialView feature; the affordances are known to the server (they are iterated at live_inference.py:824-847) and simply omitted from the aspatial branch.

findings.title: Test coverage is inverted: highest on unreachable code, lowest on the code that runs, absent on the contract that breaks
findings.evidence: 136 tests pass. criteria.py 96%, video_export.py 100%, video_renderer.py 96%, recorder.py 93% — all production-unreachable. live_inference.py 33% with command dispatch (556-631), inference loop (650-793), broadcast (798-909) and replay handlers (974-1176) all uncovered; unified_server.py 30% with the dead _start_frontend/_stop_frontend (447-546) uncovered. test_live_inference_websocket.py is named for the WebSocket protocol and its two tests only call _build_substrate_metadata — it never opens a socket. Nothing tests _handle_command. No JavaScript test can exist without package.json, so the cross-language contract has zero coverage on both sides.

findings.title: Debug scaffolding and stale action-count comments ship in the production payload
findings.evidence: The state_update dict includes `'_debug_total_episodes': self.total_episodes` under a `# DEBUG` comment (:870-871), duplicating the total_episodes field two lines above, on every broadcast. Comments at :875-876 describe 'Q-values for all 6 actions' and 'valid actions [6] bool list' for an 8-action Grid2D space. The store logs three console.log lines per state_update for Q-values (simulation.js:409-412), i.e. at 5-50 messages/sec.
